$comment: DERIVED, NON-AUTHORITATIVE release-qualification snapshot for v1.0.0-rc1, created under the Founder adjudication §9.7 closing action. It is a convenience projection of state that is authoritative ELSEWHERE. It decides nothing, qualifies nothing, and may not be cited as the source of any gate status. Where the control plane and this file disagree, the control plane wins.

snapshot_scope.what_this_is: A point-in-time projection into cybrik-suite of (a) hosted CI facts this repository verified itself read-only against the GitHub Actions API, (b) git ancestry facts verified read-only against the local canonical checkouts, and (c) governance, adjudication, performance and restore-drill records whose authority of record lives outside every suite repository.
what_this_is_not: NOT the authority of record for any gate, boundary, or decision.
NOT staging qualification, not a merge, not a release tag, not GA, not production authority.
NOT a test transcript: no per-test result is bound here, because no hosted run emits one into this repository.
snapshot_scope.authority_of_record: soc-autonomous-state:HUMAN_BOUNDARIES.json, soc-autonomous-state:AUTHORITY_INBOX.json and soc-autonomous-state:founder-uat-r22/FOUNDER-UAT-DECISION.md — control-plane artifacts outside every suite repository. This file exists BECAUSE that is true, not in spite of it: §9.7 asked for a derived artifact in-repo, and a derived artifact that claimed to be authoritative would recreate the very gap it was meant to document.
snapshot_scope.verification_split: Every field below carries an in_repository_corroboration value. VERIFIED means this repository independently observed the fact (read-only GitHub API, or read-only git against a local canonical checkout, at the snapshot timestamp). ABSENT means the claim is reproduced from an external record that nothing committed here can check. Where an external record is reproduced, its sha256 is bound so a reader can detect drift in the bytes that were read — a digest pins the source, it does not make the claim checkable here.
snapshot_scope.revision_note: Revision 4 (2026-08-21, content-base re-pin, catalog alignment and one reclassification; no new product measurement). Changes against revision 3: the cybrik-suite content base advances from 4498bdd3 to 7065a7034991e43a1f486d67f84777766b5d0cba — the authoring parent of the commit carrying this revision — verified 3/3 green read-only under GitHub Actions run 32464960479 at exactly that head (companion push-event run 32464954616 also 3/3 green), with job identifiers re-bound accordingly; SECURITY_TXT_PUBLICATION is reclassified from BLOCKING_OPEN to EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_REQUIREMENT / POST_DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED with POST_DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED as its single gating class, on unchanged facts (the URL was re-probed 404 on 2026-08-21) and without reopening or weakening RB-001; and a compound_label_rule is added to the taxonomy so the compound label cannot be read as breaking disjointness. No product suite was re-executed and no gate moved. Revision 3 (2026-08-21, classification and prose alignment; no new measurement). Changes against revision 2: residual_item_classification introduces the RESIDUAL_ITEM_CLASSIFICATION_TAXONOMY_v1 shared with RELEASE-CANDIDATE-V1.0.0-RC1.md §9.0; open_items_not_closed_by_this_snapshot becomes a list of classified objects so no item can be read as both blocking and deferred; the W2-F read-token amendment is classified DEFERRED_NON_BLOCKING_GOVERNANCE_ITEM and scenario-level NEG-1..NEG-6 rehearsal execution POST_MERGE_REQUIRED against the exact post-merge images; provenance_model mirrors the manifest's content-base / external-release-tag-envelope split; and contract_state.w2_i_transport_binding carries its obligations with explicit classes. Revision 2 (2026-08-21T16:20:00+07:00) advanced the SOC pin from 2822b9e1 to 695aed8 (rebased onto origin/main 4480a412), advanced the Suite content base to 4498bdd, moved codex_challenges, performance_evidence and database_restore_drill from NO_IN_REPOSITORY_RECORD to derived indexes of real control-plane records, and superseded dangling_evidence_references with external_evidence_reconciliation. Nothing was resolved by authoring a missing document.

database_restore_drill.supersedes: The prior revision recorded NO_IN_REPOSITORY_RECORD and correctly refused to report the service rollback rehearsal as a restore drill. Two real drills have since been executed and committed to the SOC repository; both are bound below.
database_restore_drill.classification_model: Four distinct claims are kept separate on purpose. Collapsing them is exactly the overstatement CODEX-ADJ-005 pre-merge item 3 caught: an unencrypted local drill was being cited in support of an encrypted production-backup control claim.

LOCAL_UNENCRYPTED_RESTORE_DRILL.what_it_proves: Functional restore of an UNENCRYPTED local snapshot into a scratch database, with per-table row counts matching and full checksums on audit_events and copilot_audit. Nothing more.
LOCAL_UNENCRYPTED_RESTORE_DRILL.what_it_does_not_prove: Not encrypted-backup restoration, not off-system storage, not a production RTO. Recorded as ABMB-02 by CODEX-ADJ-003.

LOCAL_ENCRYPTED_RESTORE_DRILL.bound_at_pin: 695aed8e0e12c9d0e11de5f474e3384d1a4b490f — the pinned SOC head is the commit that records this drill
LOCAL_ENCRYPTED_RESTORE_DRILL.integrity_check: sha256 of the on-disk artifact matched the backup manifest before any temporary database was created
LOCAL_ENCRYPTED_RESTORE_DRILL.what_it_proves: An age-encrypted dump was written with no plaintext on disk, verified by digest without the decryption key, then decrypted with the age identity and restored into a scratch database, with all 56 tables matching exactly on row count and with full checksums on audit_events and copilot_audit. The RTO of 1.7 s covers the restore step only, not the full recovery procedure.
LOCAL_ENCRYPTED_RESTORE_DRILL.what_it_does_not_prove: This is a LOCAL drill against a developer PostgreSQL instance with a locally held age identity. It is not evidence about production key custody, production off-system storage, or production recovery time under production data volume.
LOCAL_ENCRYPTED_RESTORE_DRILL.closes: CODEX-ADJ-005 pre-merge item 3 — the encrypted-backup control claim now has matching encrypted-drill evidence instead of being supported by the unencrypted 20260820T164433Z drill.

PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY_CUSTODY.why: The drill used a locally held age identity. Production key custody — where the age recipient's private half lives, who can use it, how it is rotated and how its use is audited — is a property of a production secret manager that does not exist yet and that no suite repository may contain. Per cybrik-suite:CLAUDE.md, production credentials, secrets and signing keys require explicit Founder approval and are outside every repository's data-handling boundary.
PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY_CUSTODY.not_claimed: No suite artifact asserts that production backup keys are provisioned, escrowed or rotated.

PRODUCTION_OFF_SYSTEM_STORAGE.why: Both drills wrote and read the artifact on the same host that ran the database. Off-system or off-site retention, immutability/object-lock and retention-period enforcement depend on production storage infrastructure that has not been provisioned.
PRODUCTION_OFF_SYSTEM_STORAGE.not_claimed: No suite artifact asserts that backups are replicated off-system or retained under an enforced policy.

PRODUCTION_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_LIVE_VERIFI.why: Verifying that the encrypted-backup control operates against the real production database — real volume, real schedule, real key custody, measured production RPO/RTO — is only possible after deployment. It is not blocked on evidence; it is blocked on there being a production system.
PRODUCTION_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_LIVE_VERIFI.closing_action: After deployment, run the encrypted drill against production on the production schedule and record measured RPO/RTO, key-custody attestation and off-system retention proof.

database_restore_drill.summary: Backup ENCRYPTION IMPLEMENTATION = VERIFIED. LOCAL RESTORE DRILL (both unencrypted and age-encrypted) = VERIFIED. PRODUCTION key custody, off-system storage and live verification = NOT VERIFIED, and deliberately not claimed.

residual_item_classification.authority: docs/releases/RELEASE-CANDIDATE-V1.0.0-RC1.md §9.0 is the authoritative statement of this taxonomy. This block is the derived projection of it and must never disagree with it.
residual_item_classification.disjointness_rule: Every residual item carries EXACTLY ONE class. No item is simultaneously blocking and deferred, and no top-level status field in this snapshot may disagree with the class recorded against the item that details it.
residual_item_classification.compound_label_rule: One item (SECURITY_TXT_PUBLICATION) carries the compound label EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_REQUIREMENT / POST_DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED. This is NOT a second class and does not break disjointness: the part before the slash names where the artifact of record lives, and the part after it is the single gating class, recorded separately as gating_class. Read the gating class only.

classes.BLOCKING_OPEN: Must be closed before v1.0.0-rc1 may leave CANDIDATE_READY_FOR_STAGING_QUALIFICATION. Gates staging qualification.
classes.POST_MERGE_REQUIRED: Cannot be executed until the four pull requests merge, because it needs artifacts built from the EXACT post-merge main-line SHAs. A sequencing fact, not a defect and not a waiver. Gates staging qualification, after merge.
classes.POST_DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED: Cannot be verified until a production deployment exists. Does not gate staging qualification.
classes.DEFERRED_NON_BLOCKING_GOVERNANCE_ITEM: A governance act at a DIFFERENT gate that this candidate does not depend on, deliberately deferred to post-RC1. It constrains future scope, not this candidate's claims. Does not gate staging qualification.
classes.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE: The authority or artifact of record lives outside every suite repository; nothing committed here can close it. Records the gap rather than gating on it.

residual_item_classification.reading_rule: DEFERRED_NON_BLOCKING_GOVERNANCE_ITEM and EXTERNAL_RESOURCE items are recorded but do NOT hold v1.0.0-rc1 at its current status. BLOCKING_OPEN and POST_MERGE_REQUIRED items do. No prose elsewhere in this file overrides that.
